bifrost: springboard/src/shell/accessibility/mod.rs (system accessibility settings only); springboard/src/media/ (playback, no caption or haptic layer)
summary: The framework exposes system caption appearance, audible media preferences, flashing-light dimming and Music Haptics. BifrOSt has the flashing-lights setting and dimming as an app-facing option. Caption appearance and audible media preferences exist as UI-crate models but are not app-facing, and there are no music haptics. The media player drops subtitle tracks at demux time. Reduce Motion and Increase Contrast exist in the shell, but they are not part of this framework.

features.feature: Caption appearance settings (font, colours, opacity, edge style, window, display type)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 7 tests. Wave 2 (theme-15, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No caption preference store in springboard/src/shell/accessibility/mod.rs or springboard/src/shell/options.rs; no caption settings page in springboard/src/shell/pages.rs.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 7 tests. Wave 2 (theme-15, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No language stack or profile API. The Options keys in springboard/src/shell/options.rs have no caption entry.

features.feature: Caption change notification and display reporting
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 7 tests. Wave 2 (theme-15, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No caption-specific notification is posted. The generic notification centre does not carry this event.

features.feature: Subtitle and caption tracks in playback
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 6 tests. Wave 3 (theme-03, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. The WebM parser drops subtitle tracks; its test asserts 'subtitle track dropped'. The MP4 path (springboard/src/media/mp4.rs, Kind: Video, Audio) has no text track either. No caption rendering exists.

features.feature: Audible media selection (described video, audio description preference)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 6 tests. Wave 3 (theme-03, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No preference is read or exposed. The player in springboard/src/media/player.rs selects audio tracks without any accessibility characteristic.

Wave 6 (b13, main): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on Midget. No flashing-light code in springboard/src or springboard/render/src. The 'flash' hits are the screenshot shutter (springboard/src/shell/screenshot.rs) and are unrelated. The magnifier (springboard/src/shell/magnifier.rs) has no photosensitivity filter. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 2 (0.5.38); verify on Midget for parity. Refreshed 2026-10-17: covered by springboard/ui/src/flashing_lights.rs (tests flashing_lights::tests), the shell setting, and the SDK DisplayOptions.dim_flashing_lights (sdk/src/accessibility_display.rs, tests accessibility_display::tests). The model takes caller-supplied samples and counts reversals, not the full photosensitivity rule.

Music Haptics plays a haptic track on the Taptic Engine of Apple hardware. PCs have no equivalent actuator, and the only vibrator code is a presence check for Keyboard Haptics. No music haptic track is played.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 8 tests. Wave 3 (theme-06, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No code reads or writes an image caption in image metadata. springboard/src/shell/md.rs only renders markdown image lines.

gaps: Caption appearance preferences: the model is in ui/src/captions.rs (profiles, text, highlight and window styles, change reporting; tests captions::tests); missing the settings page and an app-facing SDK call.
Caption and subtitle track support in the demuxers and the player (WebM drops subtitle tracks; MP4 has no text track), plus a caption renderer.
Audible media selection preferences: ui/src/media_selection.rs chooses tracks from them (tests media_selection::tests); no app-facing SDK call.
Image caption metadata API (set and read the accessibility caption of an image).
Music Haptics is n/a on PC hardware; the framework's Apple-only features are not expected to map here.
